text: INSANE: Event horizon freezes outside time in an instant!

Scientists from the U.S., China, and the EU argue over this glowing ring of accretion disc, claiming that crossing the event horizon would halt external time while tidal forces tear anything into spaghetti, a phenomenon that could rewrite physics, power future AI‑driven navigation, and spark a race for black‑hole energy extraction, igniting geopolitical tension over who controls the ultimate cosmic laboratory.
Which nation should claim the black‑hole frontier, and will AI ever guide us safely inside?
